progress.taste_review.title: Independent Scientific Taste source review
progress.taste_review.subtitle: {count} project-owned campaign has blinded materials ready; no reviewer has been contacted.
progress.taste_review.boundary: Tool Intelligence routes reversible local preparation directly and stops irreversible human recruitment at the owner boundary; no generic preflight is added.
progress.taste_review.next.awaiting_owne: Next is an owner decision on ethics, compensation, consent, conflict screening, and three independent reviewers—not another code precheck.
progress.taste_review.next.authorized_se: The three blind local session packages are ready. Return each reviewer-generated JSON here; SciTaste itself still sends no message.
progress.taste_review.next.collecting_re: Keep collecting only the remaining bound blind returns. The third valid return automatically locks the independent result.
progress.taste_review.next.review_locked: The independent result is locked. Resolve any adjudication flags, then generate and edit the Taste-abstraction plan from this evidence.
progress.taste_review.generate: Generate and edit a review coordination plan
progress.taste_review.followup: Using the bound campaign, generate and edit an actionable but non-authorizing coordination plan for {candidates} candidates. Allocate exactly {scientific} scientific reviewers and {privacy} privacy reviewer across {assessments} judgments; show ethics, compensation, consent, conflict screening, blinding, and result-lock steps. Treat the current {gap}-call abstraction capacity gap against {capacity} calls as a worst-case forecast, not observed demand. Preserve direct_path for local preparation and owner_approval for human recruitment, add no generic preflight, and do not claim recruitment or experiment completion.
progress.taste_review.result_followup: Edit the plan around this locked independent result: {eligible} source candidates are eligible and {adjudication} require adjudication. Resolve scientific or privacy disagreement before compiling abstraction inputs. The pre-plan ceiling is {ceiling}, current single-profile capacity is {capacity}, and the forecast gap is {gap}; do not mistake this ceiling for exact demand, run a model, or claim corpus admission.
progress.taste_review.abstraction_follow: Using only the locked source-review evidence, generate and edit a grounded contrastive Taste-abstraction plan for {inputs} eligible inputs. Show the same-source Raw RAG control, exact source grounding, transfer boundaries, one-call-per-source rule, two independent abstraction reviews, and split-only adjudication. The current single-profile capacity is {capacity}, leaving a {gap}-call gap across {eligible} eligible sources and {adjudication} unresolved source-review items. Do not run a model, hide the capacity gap, add a generic preflight, or claim corpus/benchmark admission.
progress.taste_review.authorize.open: Record owner decision and prepare blind sessions
progress.taste_review.authorize.boundary: Use project-local pseudonyms only—never names, email addresses, or contact details. This authorizes recruitment and prepares files, but sends no message.
progress.taste_review.authorize.retentio: Retention and withdrawal terms are confirmed.

progress.taste_review.authorize.ready_bo: Authorization grants no model, API, GPU, or experiment authority; no human contact was performed.

progress.taste_review.abstraction.foreca: Resource forecast · at most {ceiling} abstraction candidates versus {capacity} calls in one current profile: worst-case gap {gap}. Exact demand waits for the locked independent review result.

landscape.types.title: Contribution types, not one mixed list
landscape.types.subtitle: Paper type and experimental use are recorded independently.
landscape.type.method.description: Changes how an autonomous research system searches, learns, executes, or revises.
landscape.type.hybrid.description: Makes inseparable method and benchmark contributions in the same accepted paper.
landscape.type.benchmark.description: Contributes tasks, environments, rubrics, judges, or a capability study.

landscape.tracks.title: Two inputs to one matched experiment
landscape.tracks.subtitle: Systems are compared; benchmarks and judges measure them. Hybrid papers are decomposed and may inform both tracks.
landscape.track.systems.purpose: Accepted methods and the system portion of hybrid papers supply candidate research agents.
landscape.track.resources.purpose: Benchmarks, tasks, datasets, rubrics, and judges define what the systems are measured on.
landscape.track.protocol.purpose: A formal cell exists only after one unchanged-core system and one qualified evaluation package share task, model, budget, telemetry, and judging contracts.
landscape.lenses.title: What is actually measured
landscape.lenses.subtitle: Six estimands stay separate; paper fluency cannot stand in for execution.
landscape.matrix.title: Lifecycle coverage
landscape.matrix.subtitle: Methods, hybrids, and benchmarks stay in separate lanes; a dot marks stage coverage, not one persistent trajectory.
landscape.candidates.title: Comparison readiness
landscape.candidates.subtitle: Reference means understood; adaptation means integration work exists; formal requires a qualified matched run.
landscape.candidates.resources: Benchmarks and judges used to evaluate
landscape.gates.title: Can experiment planning proceed?
